events.title: DEMO Hotfix - v0.0.10
events.summary: A bunch of new fixes and improvements just went up: Accessibility: - Add the option to remove Motion Blur. - Add the option to remove Head Bob. - Add the option to remove Film Grain. - Add a checkbox to Disable Copyrighted Music. - Mouse Sensitivity settings will now apply to the Paint Roller correctly. Improvements - NPCs will now be much less likely to generate trash in cleaner rooms. - Added a notification whenever documents are sent to the Found Papers tray. - Improve readability of furnitur

events.title: DEMO Hotfix - v0.0.9
events.summary: The demo has been updated - thank you for the feedback!Patch notes, hotfix v0.0.9- Enable the player to progress the quest line if the delivery truck is sent away first.- Putting the 4 delivery boxes on the shelf will now correctly always progress the questline.- Greatly reduce the physics impact on delivery boxes which caused them to be lost, blocking progression. - It should no longer be possible to put the delivery box back onto the truck through the trailer door, which blocked progression.-

events.title: DEMO Hotfix - v0.0.8
events.summary: Patch notes v0.0.8You can no longer order an incomplete furniture set during the tutorial quest for the Catalog App.Reduce initial trash, stain, dust positions to improve their visibility. This will result in faster initial room activation in general.You will now get a notification when manually saving the game.Change how player character model behaves when using the Power Washer.Various minor map adjustments, collider and material optimalization improvements.

events.title: DEMO Hotfix - Corrupted Timeline
events.summary: It seems our officers didn't understand how time zones work which caused problems with shift reports delivery for players in some countries. We made sure that all of the police officers work in a single predetermined time zone from now on :)For those of you who encountered the missing report bug - please start a new game after the update. The timeline from your savefile has been corrupted and you need to get onto the main timeline to avoid time paradoxes and collapsing of the whole universe.Chan
